<MethodEndpoint
  method={"patch"}
  path={"/api/v1/series"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Partially updates a series. Any subset of the supported body fields may be provided — only
the fields you send are updated; everything else is left untouched. A single request may
combine multiple updates (for example, renaming the series and changing settings in one call).

**Supported body fields:**
- `displayName` *(string)* — update the series display name.
- `settings` *(object)* — hierarchical player+picker settings (same schema as returned by
  `GET /api/v1/series?includeSettings=true`). Only the paths you send are merged onto the
  existing settings — absent paths are untouched. Unknown API paths cause a `400` error.

**Settings merge semantics:**
- Boolean / integer / enum fields: the new value replaces the old one.
- String fields: the new value replaces the old one. Sending `""` sets the field to empty.

**Examples:**

**Rename a series:**
```bash
curl -L -X PATCH 'https://sandbox.amuselabs.com/pmm/api/v1/series?series=api-demo-crossword' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"displayName": "API Demo (Updated)"}'
```

**Update specific settings:**
```bash
curl -L -X PATCH 'https://sandbox.amuselabs.com/pmm/api/v1/series?series=api-demo-crossword' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "settings": {
      "scoring": { "correctAnswer": 20, "targetTime": 10 },
      "sharing": { "enabled": true, "twitterHandle": "@AmuseLabs" }
    }
  }'
```

**Rename and update settings in one call:**
```bash
curl -L -X PATCH 'https://sandbox.amuselabs.com/pmm/api/v1/series?series=api-demo-crossword' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "displayName": "API Demo (Updated)",
    "settings": { "assistFeatures": { "hints": false } }
  }'
```
